children: is asking the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to allow users of its prediction platform the ability to make bets on margin, mirroring similar transactions that commonly occur on Wall Street.
In a filing with the CFTC, Kalshi Klear — Kalshi’s

CFTC-regulated derivatives clearinghouse – asked for approval to amend its registration to implement a “new initial margin methodology for eligible event contracts.” The new framework will apply to any “verifiable events” that Kalshi users can bet on, except any event that involves a sporting contest.
currently allows margin bets on its perpetual futures contracts tied to precious metals, but not for prediction markets.
By offering leverage for prediction bets, Kalshi
aims to increase larger bets and those for a longer duration than currently provided.
If approved by the CFTC, Kalshi
would only allow margin bets to be placed by customers approved by Kalshi Klear as a self-clearing member.

title: Kalshi asks CFTC to approve margin trades for prediction markets
